assumption: Public shares are nonnegative and sum to one.
consequence_if_violated: LP bounds are undefined outside the simplex.
claim_boundary: Use feasible support intervals, not recovered votes.

assumption: Observed eliminations imply documented combined-score inequalities.
consequence_if_violated: Incorrect rule coding changes the compatible set.

assumption: Public input is a strict rank permutation.
consequence_if_violated: Weak orders require a different model.
claim_boundary: Ordinal feasible rankings are not cardinal shares.

assumption: Named judge-rank tie policy is applied.
consequence_if_violated: Tie policy can alter feasible rankings.
claim_boundary: Report tie-policy sensitivity and no universal rank truth.

assumption: R_plus weak condition permits bottom-(k+1) membership.
consequence_if_violated: Direct and weak readings identify different sets.
claim_boundary: Expert discretion is an auditable governance tradeoff.

assumption: Synthetic releases add truthful compatible constraints.
consequence_if_violated: Incompatible/noisy releases need not shrink a set.
claim_boundary: Disclosure ordering is claimed only for nested compatible additions.

assumption: The simulator hides latent public shares/ranks from inference.
claim_boundary: Known truth exists only inside the synthetic simulator.

assumption: Noisy outcomes intentionally violate the generating rule.
claim_boundary: Noise result is a stress test, not prediction accuracy.

assumption: Configurations and predicates are predeclared and applicable.
claim_boundary: RRI is bounded support share, not optimality.

assumption: User-supplied inputs are documented and valid.
consequence_if_violated: Missing/invalid inputs yield no defensible recommendation.
claim_boundary: Artifact gives conditional design guidance only.
